change: S1a is the alert path: the native part of each window against the workload's t3 threshold (alpha' 0.0003, unchanged) OR the session part against one pooled session model at alpha' 0.00015 (TokenBranch with tokens.session; SESSION.json from scripts/analysis/session_branch_config.py --branch-alpha 0.0003).
